687-728-5004--73.easyPrerequisites: The creature with persist or undying doesn't  have a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it respective to its ability.
687-728-5004--73.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cathodion.
Cathodion triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing your persist/undying creature.
The creature's persist/undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a vigilance counter and the appropriate choice of a +1/+1 or -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing  both counters from your persist/undying creature and one counter from another creature, causing yourself to mill three cards and return Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2645-3430-3664-4348.easyPrerequisites: Ley Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-3664-4348.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.

1150-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1116-1263-2438-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-3043-5223.description:

Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

392-5078-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Repeat.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-3019-7373.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Tellah
1618-2440-3019-7373.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Tellah triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain.
Repeat.
1618-2440-3019-7373.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Tellah. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

1394-2060-5147-7038-7267.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Michelangelo.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Michelangelo.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

240-413-5470-6968.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

252-1575-3698-5776.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Food.
Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
When the Treasure enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2292-6248-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.

When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Phenomenon Investigators and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4017-4050-5086-5183-6753.description:

Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {4}{B}, creating a creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 2.

Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

Repeat.

When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.

When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

2060-2744-2921-3327.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2060-2744-2921-3327.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

Sea Tyrant of Segovia.

Resolve Corpse Dance, returning Vampire Hexmage from your graveyard to the battlefield and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.

When the Elementals enter the battlefield, they trigger Anointer Priest four times.
Resolve the first Anointer Priest trigger, causing you to gain one life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

112-565-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
112-565-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Great Whale.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
The Great Whale token enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you can target any permanents you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.
